stemBlocks: Four identical springs are arranged as shown and suspended from a support. The mass of the springs, rod and hook are negligible. A load of weight $8.4 \text{ N}$ is attached to the hook at the lower end of the springs and this causes a total extension of the system of $24 \text{ mm}$. The arrangement is then changed to: The load of $8.4 \text{ N}$ is attached to the bottom of the lower spring.
What is the total extension of the system at equilibrium in the second arrangement? (The springs obey Hooke's law.)
